title: You're Moving 2,000,000 km/h Right Now (You Just Can't Feel It)

scenes.voiceover: Right now, sitting perfectly still, you are moving at over two million kilometers per hour.
scenes.visualConcept: A person standing dead still at night while the universe screams past them.

scenes.voiceover: You feel completely still. But you are being hurled through space in four different ways at once.
scenes.visualConcept: A lone silhouette looking up at a slowly wheeling night sky.

scenes.voiceover: One. The Earth spins. At the equator, the ground under you is turning at about one thousand six hundred kilometers per hour.
scenes.visualConcept: Earth rotating, terminator line sweeping across the surface.

scenes.voiceover: Two. Earth is racing around the Sun at over one hundred thousand kilometers per hour.
scenes.visualConcept: Earth arcing along its orbit, the Sun blazing at frame edge.

scenes.voiceover: Three. The Sun drags the entire solar system around the galaxy at eight hundred and twenty eight thousand kilometers per hour.
scenes.visualConcept: The solar system as a spiraling comet-trail sweeping around the galactic core.

scenes.voiceover: Four. And the entire galaxy is falling through the universe at over two million kilometers per hour.
scenes.visualConcept: The whole Milky Way rushing through the cosmic web toward the Great Attractor.

scenes.voiceover: Stack it all together, and the truth is simple. You have never once been still. Not for a single second of your life.
scenes.visualConcept: A dizzying zoom out from a single still person to the whole racing cosmos.

scenes.voiceover: You feel none of it, because everything around you is moving with you. Motion only exists compared to something else.
scenes.visualConcept: A calm person on a rooftop, utterly still, as the stars streak behind them.

scenes.voiceover: Follow Mindwired for the universe you can't feel.
scenes.visualConcept: Wordmark over a slow star drift.
